resources.string: SharpMind uses this only during a focus session you start, to notice configured distracting surfaces such as YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels and leave them. It does not read passwords, store messages, record the screen, or upload window content. Turn it off any time in Android Settings → Accessibility. SharpMind cannot prevent you from disabling it.
